# CIE 1931 standard colorimetric observer

CIE 2019, *Colour-matching functions of CIE 1931 standard colorimetric
observer*, International Commission on Illumination (CIE), Vienna, AT.
[DOI 10.25039/CIE.DS.xvudnb9b](https://doi.org/10.25039/CIE.DS.xvudnb9b).
Original source is CIE 018:2019, Table 6.

The CSV and metadata are unmodified from the [official dataset page](https://cie.co.at/datatable/cie-1931-colour-matching-functions-2-degree-observer).
The CSV SHA-256 is `fa663e3535a7e0763a745993a1f0a192eb0275ac46ad2d1befd7626841e713c1`.
